method: multi-turn conversation templates (src/trillic/dialogue.py — five families ported from 0xnicholas/tokencamp compression/eval/conversation_gen.py, same author, five new) + seeded slot synthesis; prompt = user/assistant history + final user recall message, serialized as 'role: content' lines; key_points are history facts (names/dates/prior decisions) that quote the history verbatim so survival is judgeable after compression; per-family DISJOINT eval/train integer seed ranges in dialogue_families.toml are the split authority — golden draws from eval seeds only; the phase-2 training side will reuse the same templates and machinery with train seeds (shared code, never shared seeds)

families.name: support_ticket
families.description: Webhook delivery failure: root cause (egress IP rotation), allowlist fix, retry policy, impact window
families.note: Ported scenario 1; optional deeper round (signing-secret rotation) spliced by seeded slot.

families.name: pair_programming
families.description: Flaky idempotency test: check-then-act race diagnosis, ON CONFLICT fix, prod dupes cleanup, double-captured amount
families.note: Ported scenario 2; carries code blocks (template braces escaped).

families.name: requirements_discussion
families.description: PRD alignment: v1 boundary (admins/UI only), async jobs, retention, rate-limit cap, no-partial-artifacts invariant
families.note: Ported scenario 3; decision-dense with numbers (queue cap, retention, effort).

families.name: data_pipeline
families.description: Overnight metric drop: inner-join row loss diagnosis, privacy ruling, LEFT JOIN fix, 12-day restatement
families.note: Ported scenario 4; SQL join semantics carry the decisions.

families.name: devops_incident
families.description: SEV incident: retry-storm root cause, rollback-first mitigation, fix-forward plan with owners and timeline
families.note: Ported scenario 5; timestamps and revision ids are seeded.

families.name: vendor_procurement
families.description: Contract renewal negotiation: discount-for-term target, notice/cap clauses, conditional SOC 2, DPA routing, fallback
families.license: original (authored in this repo, no third-party content)
families.note: New family: clause-level decisions with dates, percentages, and named owner.

families.name: onboarding_rollout
families.description: Customer migration: freeze window constraint, phased-vs-big-bang decision, pilot and cutover dates, rollback window
families.license: original (authored in this repo, no third-party content)
families.note: New family: date-dense planning dialogue; recall task mirrors steering-committee briefing.

families.name: bug_triage
families.description: Weekly triage: severity call with rationale, ownership, milestone, backport decision, regression-test commitment
families.license: original (authored in this repo, no third-party content)
families.note: New family: names + versions + dates; severity reasoning must survive.

families.name: access_review
families.description: Access grant review: scope/conditions/expiry decision, bastion-only rule, approver, standing-access re-review date
families.license: original (authored in this repo, no third-party content)
families.note: New family: compliance-grade precision — every grant parameter is a key fact.

families.name: release_planning
families.description: Release cut: locked ship date, feature cut to next version, migration owner/time, canary plan, code freeze
families.license: original (authored in this repo, no third-party content)
families.note: New family: the ship-review recap is the recall task.

checked: each conversation reads as a realistic multi-turn exchange
the final user message asks the assistant to recall history facts
key_points are history facts (names/dates/prior decisions), not constraints or final-message-only claims
seeded values embedded in key_points quote the history verbatim
review.notes: Owner authorized approval in the issue-#8 gate question; dialogue pilot entries re-verified against regeneration before signing.
